title: Keyed copy of the dropped column — the documented targeted pattern
expected_feedback: Standard, not critical: this is the targeted snapshot the reference recommends. The copy carries the primary key and the column being dropped, which is exactly what recovery needs — a MERGE back keyed on id. Demanding a full-table copy here would be wasteful on 6M rows and would contradict the skill's own guidance. Two things still to confirm, because the checker cannot: that `id` really is the primary key (a copy keyed on a non-unique column cannot be merged back), and that the CTAS completed before the drop ran. The phase remains restore/PITR — the drop auto-commits and Flashback Table cannot cross it — and someone should own dropping the backup table at sign-off.
violated_rule: Irreversible statements need a pre-DDL artefact
